name: PhotoApp sources
description: The Photo app (raster editing): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/PhotoApp, built from SuiteUI's SuiteWindow: the window and its intents, the window toolbar (Open, Save and Export beside the title, Undo, Redo and zoom trailing) with the save status as its subtitle, the layer list in the sidebar, the canvas under a floating tool palette with the status line beneath it, the inspector with no tabs (an image header, tool options, the selected layer's blend settings, and adjustment sections with the Levels gamma ScrubField and the Curves tone curve over its histogram), the export, image size and straighten sheets (the straighten preview turns the canvas picture on the GPU under a grid), the File, Edit (Undo, Redo, and Cut, Copy and Paste on the image unless a text field has focus or a sheet is up), Select, Image, Layer and View menus, the general pasteboard read and written as PNG and TIFF (PhotoPasteboard) and watched for the Edit menu, the coalescing canvas renderer, the stroke pacer that applies a display frame's drag samples at once, the pen pressure and the Option key read from AppKit for canvas drags, the window's autosave to a recovery file and its restore offer at launch (PhotoAutosave), the app delegate (Finder opens, and the unsaved-changes prompt on Quit) and the window's close guard that asks before a dirty window closes, and the ImageIO codec behind PhotoModel's PhotoImageCodec.
